title: Extending property tax relief for wildfire-hit properties
summary: On August 25, 2026, Bill 103 changed the budget tied to the real property tax expiry date for wildfire-impacted properties. The bill would extend the exemption's end date from December 31, 2026, to June 30, 2028, which the budget director said lines it up with Ordinance 5913. Earlier bills had already moved to extend wildfire tax relief through June 30, 2028.
